page.overview:
Who is Trike Feldman?

Trike appears during the race at Porto Corsa. His job is to sell Francesco Bernoulli merchandise to the race fans. He is seen when Finn McMissile drives to the tower to prevent Grem and Acer from causing the racers to crash, where the camera frames a bus who is fighting with Trike until they notice Finn detouring by them.
